The '''2023 Supercopa de España final''' was a [[Association football|football]] match that decided the winner of the [[2023 Supercopa de España]], the 39th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 15 January 2023 at the [[King Fahd International Stadium]] in [[Riyadh]], Saudi Arabia. The match was '[[El Clásico]]' between the [[2021–22 La Liga]] winners [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] and its runners-up [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], the eighth time both clubs played each other in the competition's decisive tie (until [[2020 Supercopa de España|2020]] its format was simply a two-legged match; the teams were meeting in their first final under the four-team setup having played a semi-final in [[2022 Supercopa de España|2022]]).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://olympics.com/en/news/supercopa-de-espana-2022-23-final-real-madrid-vs-barcelona-el-clasico-time |title=Spanish Super Cup 2022-23 final: Real Madrid vs Barcelona in first El Clasico of the year |work=Olympics |date=14 January 2023 |access-date=15 January 2023}}</ref>

Barcelona won the match 3–1 for their 14th Supercopa de España title.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/64268835|title=Real Madrid1 Barcelona 3|date=15 January 2023|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=21 February 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/jan/15/gavi-helps-barcelona-ease-past-real-madrid-to-win-spanish-super-cup|title=Barcelona ease past Real Madrid to win Spanish Super Cup as PSG lose again|date=15 January 2023|work=Guardian|accessdate=21 February 2023}}</ref>

'''Match rules'''
*90 minutes.
*30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] if necessary.
*[[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|Penalty shoot-out]] if scores still level.
*Eleven named substitutes.
*Maximum of five substitutions, with a sixth allowed in extra time.{{refn|group=note|Each team was given only three opportunities to make substitutions, with a fourth opportunity in extra time, excluding substitutions made at half-time, before the start of extra time and at half-time in extra time.}}
